## Problem

Describe the repeated manual task, bottleneck, or operational friction.

## Frequency

How often does this happen?

- [ ] multiple times daily
- [ ] daily
- [ ] weekly
- [ ] monthly

## Current process

Describe the current manual workflow.

## Desired automation

Describe the ideal automated or AI-assisted flow.

## Risk level

- [ ] low
- [ ] medium
- [ ] high

## Validation plan

How should this automation be tested safely?

## Rollback plan

How can the automation be disabled or reverted?
